species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 71°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 8–42 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
South wind at 20 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.

species.name: Trout
why: Water 71°F on top, warmer than they like, so they go deeper and into the shade.
Best water today is 8–44 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 71°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
